title: debug stats readback toggle
description:
Wire the missing UI caller for the preview stats-readback toggle
(the trace-dims instrument's A/B switch, follow-up to 8204d7e):

Settings (debug builds): a 'Preview stats readback' switch row
under the Measure button — an M3 ListItem with a trailing Switch,
the whole row toggleable at the 48dp minimum (the editor's
RawToggleRow convention: the Switch carries no own click handler,
the row speaks as one control). Release builds never render the
row, never call the setter — the native default (on) is exactly
the pre-toggle behavior.

Persistence: PreviewStatsStore, the RenderBackendStore pattern —
same shared files/project.json, own top-level 'previewStats'
BOOLEAN scalar (JsonParser parses true/false, renderRaw
re-renders them), omit-when-default so a never-toggled file stays
byte-identical and off-then-on removes the key. Absent key, null,
